$source.note: After Alexander Rodchenko and the constructivists. The PDF is set in the rodchenko layout (render/layouts/rodchenko.ts): a poster cover — red circle, the title on a diagonal band, the cover's lines on rays from a megaphone after "Books!" — and inside, sections opened by a black girder and a large red number, black-rule tables, arrows for bullets, and gates that climb. Roboto Condensed stands in for the hand-drawn grotesques. Word gets the ordinary page in these colours and faces. No artwork of Rodchenko's or anyone else's is used.
